outcome: growth of preterm newborns with gastroschisis
cohort: Preterm newborns (gestational age less than 37 weeks) with simple and complex gastroschisis
finding: More than 90% of preterm newborns with gastroschisis demonstrated acceptable or adequate weight gain during their hospitalization in the neonatal intensive care unit.
mod_finding: This study found that 80% of preterm newborns with gastroschisis were delivered via cesarean section.
